title: Ateian Fife
flavorText: A masterfully crafted fife, bearing the mark of a legendary family of flutemakers. Bring this to the Bards College in Solitude, in Western Skyrim.
name: Ateian Fife

title: Shriek-of-Silk
flavorText: An old vossa-satl, the enchanted frogs that produce its sound may long have died. Bring this to the Bards College in Solitude, in Western Skyrim.
name: Shriek-of-Silk

title: Kothringi Leviathan Bugle
flavorText: A stunning silver-blue horn of simple design, but has a powerful ringing tone. Bring this to the Bards College in Solitude, in Western Skyrim.
name: Kothringi Leviathan Bugle

title: Endless Pouch of Proofs
flavorText: This pouch contains a bounty of Arena Gladiator Proofs and Siege of Cyrodiil Merits.
name: Endless Pouch of Proofs

title: Lodestone
flavorText: A lyre of incomprehensible craftsmanship, said to have been swindled from Sheogorath by Callisos. Bring this to the Bards College in Solitude, in Western Skyrim.
name: Lodestone

title: Dozzen Talharpa
flavorText: A crude version of a lyre, crafted by Jibhan from the sinew of his late twin brother. Bring this to the Bards College in Solitude, in Western Skyrim.
name: Dozzen Talharpa

title: Ring of Winter's Respite
name: Ring of Winter's Respite

setBonuses.description: (5 items) While in combat, casting abilities that leave an effect on the ground will create a circle of healing frost for |cffffff10|r seconds. You and your group members restore |cffffff2306|r Health every |cffffff2|r seconds while inside the circle. This effect can occur once every |cffffff10|r seconds and scales off the higher of your Max Magicka or Stamina.

traitDescription: Increases Maximum Magicka by |cffffff17|r.

title: Anvil of Old Orsinium
flavorText: Add a touch of Old Orsinium to your home with this well-crafted anvil and cinder-dousing bearskin rug.
name: Anvil of Old Orsinium

title: Void-Crystal Anomaly
flavorText: Floating serenely, these black crystals provide an unsettling focal point to any garden or room.
name: Void-Crystal Anomaly

title: Branch of Falinesti
flavorText: Formed by the Bosmer tree shapers of the Walking City, this throne subtly conforms to whomever sits upon it, providing strangely comfortable seating from this ancient hardwood.
name: Branch of Falinesti

title: Hollowbone Wind Chimes
flavorText: This mix of bone, metal, and sinew provides a strangely soothing and meditative sound.
name: Hollowbone Wind Chimes

title: Rune-Carved Mammoth Skull
flavorText: The metal accents on this well-dressed mammoth skull add much to its impressive staging.
name: Rune-Carved Mammoth Skull

title: Nest of Shadows
flavorText: Deadly and dramatic, this metal serpent encircles, and some say threatens, the lavender-hued egg nestled in its coils.
name: Nest of Shadows

title: Prismatic Sunbird Feather
flavorText: Gloriously stunning doesn't even begin to describe this unusual feather. Allow it to light up a dark nook or perhaps place it front and center in your personal collection of eye-catching objects.
name: Prismatic Sunbird Feather

title: Remnant of the False Tower
flavorText: Rich rose-hued colors delight the eye when gazing upon this unusual stone remnant.
name: Remnant of the False Tower

title: Silvenari Sap-Stone
flavorText: This lovely sap-stone can add both a touch of the Green and dramatic flair to any wall you choose to place it upon.
name: Silvenari Sap-Stone

title: Sorcerer-King's Blade
flavorText: Complete with its own stone display furnishing, this broken blade was once wielded by an Ayleid ruler who held mastery over great magic.
name: Sorcerer-King's Blade

title: Spellscar Shard
flavorText: This captivating shard of the great obelisk retains just enough energy to emit a dramatic fire and electrical show.
name: Spellscar Shard

title: Yokudan Skystone Scabbard
flavorText: Imagine what the sword that belonged to this stunning scabbard might have looked like! As it stands, the scabbard alone deserves all the attention it garners.
name: Yokudan Skystone Scabbard

title: Tri-Angled Truth Altar
flavorText: With markings that show veneration to old gods, this splendid altar required consummate geometric knowledge to create.
name: Tri-Angled Truth Altar

title: Clothing Station (Stuhn's Favor)
flavorText: When placed in your home, allows you to craft Clothing items in the Stuhn's Favor item set.
name: Clothing Station (Stuhn's Favor)

title: Kingmaker's Trove
flavorText: Eye-catching, is it not? This gorgeous chest requires more than a second look to take in all its masterful filigree and accents.
name: Kingmaker's Trove

title: Warcaller's Painted Drum
flavorText: No musical instrument collection is complete without this massive drum. When used, all who hear it feel its beat deep within their bones.
name: Warcaller's Painted Drum

title: Dwemer Star Chart
flavorText: Show off your love of Dwarven astronomical knowledge by placing this wondrous star chart in your home.
name: Dwemer Star Chart

title: Antique Map of Glenumbra
flavorText: This detailed map highlights the complex topography of Glenumbra thanks to the artistry of the cartographer who crafted it.
name: Antique Map of Glenumbra

title: Antique Map of Stormhaven
flavorText: Even early maps of Stormhaven like this one show population centers, making the map a window into the past.
name: Antique Map of Stormhaven

title: Antique Map of Rivenspire
flavorText: Somehow the cartographer behind this map accurately rendered Rivenspire in great detail through all its gloom and fog.
name: Antique Map of Rivenspire

title: Antique Map of Alik'r Desert
flavorText: This map maker's aesthetic depicts the vast desert of Alik'r in gentle flowing lines, representing dunes that have long since shifted.
name: Antique Map of Alik'r Desert

title: Antique Map of Bangkorai
flavorText: The entire region of Bangkorai is shown on this antique map, though much of the detail is focused on the daunting Bangkorai pass.
name: Antique Map of Bangkorai

title: Antique Map of Stonefalls
flavorText: Though the ashfall may obscure the features of Stonefalls, the clear lines of this map are an able guide.
name: Antique Map of Stonefalls

title: Antique Map of Deshaan
flavorText: The fertile plain of Deshaan stretches out on this artful map.
name: Antique Map of Deshaan

title: Antique Map of Shadowfen
flavorText: On this aged map, someone took great pains to depict the common paths and hazardous areas of the mire called Shadowfen.
name: Antique Map of Shadowfen

title: Antique Map of Eastmarch
flavorText: A master cartographer lent their skills to the crafting of this map of Eastmarch untold years ago.
name: Antique Map of Eastmarch

title: Antique Map of The Rift
flavorText: Despite its name, the sweeping temperate zone called the Rift is a hospitable place for Nords to come together, and this map points the way.
name: Antique Map of The Rift

title: Antique Map of Auridon
flavorText: One of the Summerset Isles, Auridon is painstakingly rendered on this map to the exacting standard of the College of Sapiarchs.
name: Antique Map of Auridon

title: Antique Map of Grahtwood
flavorText: Careful attention was paid to marking the well-trod footpaths through the old growth of Grahtwood.
name: Antique Map of Grahtwood

title: Antique Map of Greenshade
flavorText: Nearly a work of art in itself, this map of Greenshade provides some insight into what the region might have looked like in an earlier time.
name: Antique Map of Greenshade

title: Antique Map of Malabal Tor
flavorText: The cartographer paid special attention to the coast and waterways of Malabal Tor when rendering this map.
name: Antique Map of Malabal Tor

title: Antique Map of Reaper's March
flavorText: Skillful strokes create the boundaries and landmarks of Reaper's March on this map.
name: Antique Map of Reaper's March

title: Antique Map of Tamriel
flavorText: Though it details only major settlements and provincial boundaries, this continental map of Tamriel makes a good frame of reference for world travelers.
name: Antique Map of Tamriel

title: Antique Map of Wrothgar
flavorText: The treacherous mountains of Wrothgar are expertly depicted on this map, though safe passage through them is anyone's guess.
name: Antique Map of Wrothgar

title: Antique Map of Vvardenfell
flavorText: The vastness of Red Mountain is truly apparent in this scale map of Vvardenfell.
name: Antique Map of Vvardenfell

title: Antique Map of Summerset
flavorText: While one wouldn't want to use this map for navigation, given its age, it makes for excellent wall art.
name: Antique Map of Summerset

title: Antique Map of Murkmire
flavorText: The surveyor who succeeded in mapping the impenetrable marshlands of Murkmire made certain to note the migration of swamp leviathans.
name: Antique Map of Murkmire

title: Antique Map of Northern Elsweyr
flavorText: The lands of Anequina and its majestic aqueduct are the subject of this skillfully illustrated map.
name: Antique Map of Northern Elsweyr

title: Antique Map of Southern Elsweyr
flavorText: The kingdom of Pellitine stretches out like a lazing senche on this artistically rendered map.
name: Antique Map of Southern Elsweyr
